description: Post an operator comment on a crew (optionally @-mentioning teammates by uid). Comments are for people: the crew does not read them, and a comment does not resume or redirect a crew. To steer a crew that is running, use anyforge_message_crew. To send a crew waiting at its approval gate back to work with instructions, use anyforge_amend_crew. Requires `write` scope.

messageId.description: Optional crewChat message id to anchor the comment to.

name: anyforge_post_crew_comment
title: Post crew comment
